title: Bar Group
description: UI component for grouping multiple bar elements together.
content:
Bar Group

UI component for grouping and laying out multiple bar elements such as health and resource indicators.

Component UI

Schema

JSON
"barGroup": {
  "spacing": 0.0,
  "orientation": "..."
}

Description

The BarGroup component groups and manages multiple bar UI elements. It provides layout coordination for collections of bars, such as health and mana bars displayed together in a HUD. The component handles spacing and orientation so that grouped bars are rendered consistently.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
spacingfloatPixel spacing between each bar in the group.
orientationstringLayout direction for the bars ("horizontal" or "vertical").

Example

JSON
{
  "components": {
    "barGroup": {
      "spacing": 4.0,
      "orientation": "vertical"
    }
  }
}
